purpose: Activate exactly one exclusive Platform main V333 authoring lease for SYS-006 after the sealed owner packet, zero-finding independent review and exact clean worktree materialization. This lease grants no source, test, commit or push authority by itself and becomes authoring authority only together with the matching executable SYS-006 start token v1.

sharedReceiptSchemaException.rule: Reuse the V327-owned table and identity seal. V333 may augment only its transition/terminal guard and SYS-006 aggregate tuple constraints; it must not create a second receipt store, controller or route.
sharedReceiptSchemaException.aggregateTuple: aggregate_public_id, aggregate_revision and result_ref are all-null or all-present; aggregate_revision is positive when present
sharedReceiptSchemaException.resultUnknownRule: Evidence-reconciliation CAS only; never infer a run transition or authorize blind redispatch.

sharedReceiptDecision.runStateSeparation: RESULT_UNKNOWN is a command receipt state and never an automation run state.
sharedReceiptDecision.identityImmutability: V327's existing seal remains authoritative and exhaustively keeps these nineteen physical columns immutable: public_id, tenant_id, command_type, originating_action, subject_principal_public_id, population_scope_digest, authority_population_scope_digest, field_policy_revision, authority_field_policy_revision, purpose_code, authorization_revision, authority_authorization_revision, origin_route_contract_key, origin_context_key, origin_context_scope_key, origin_decision_revision, idempotency_key, request_digest and correlation_id. SYS-006 neither weakens nor replaces that trigger.

storageMapping.aggregateRevision: sys_hris_command_receipts.aggregate_revision; this is the physical mapping for the historical public Receipt.aggregateVersion field

sharedReceiptDecision.terminalGuard: SUCCEEDED, REJECTED and FAILED are terminal; V333 augments the shared receipt trigger or an equivalent database constraint so status, aggregate_public_id, aggregate_revision, result_ref, error_code and completed_at cannot change after those states. RESULT_UNKNOWN is quiescent but nonterminal and may advance only through evidence reconciliation CAS. Every allowed transition writes an immutable audit/outbox fact in the same transaction.

statusFieldRules.ACCEPTED: resultRef, aggregatePublicId, aggregateRevision, error and completedAt are null.
statusFieldRules.RUNNING: resultRef, aggregatePublicId and aggregateRevision are either all present after aggregate allocation or all null before allocation; error and completedAt are null.
statusFieldRules.REJECTED: resultRef, aggregatePublicId and aggregateRevision are null; error and completedAt are required.
statusFieldRules.SUCCEEDED: resultRef, aggregatePublicId, positive aggregateRevision and completedAt are required; error is null.
statusFieldRules.FAILED: completedAt and error are required; resultRef, aggregatePublicId and positive aggregateRevision are either all present for an allocated aggregate or all null when failure preceded allocation.
statusFieldRules.RESULT_UNKNOWN: completedAt is null; resultRef, aggregatePublicId and positive aggregateRevision are either all present for an allocated aggregate or all null when allocation itself is uncertain; error is required and identifies the reconciliation class.

sharedReceiptDecision.pairing: For SYS-006, resultRef, aggregatePublicId and aggregateRevision are an all-null or all-present tuple. When present, resultRef resolves the exact definition, version, schedule or run identified by aggregatePublicId and aggregateRevision is the positive revision observed by the receipt; the three physical columns are never populated independently.
sharedReceiptDecision.reconciliation: A RESULT_UNKNOWN receipt triggers an authorized aggregate reload and external evidence reconciliation; it never changes the run by inference and never authorizes blind redispatch.
sharedReceiptDecision.immutabilityClaim: The shared receipt is identity-sealed and terminal-guarded current state. Immutable audit/outbox records and immutable terminal item-attempt receipts retain its transition history; the mutable current row is never described as a wholly immutable ledger.

exactEvidencePersistence.freshnessRules: A signed definition, version or schedule subject mutation increments subject_revision and object_revision, changes the corresponding digest and invalidates validation, submission and approval evidence. Lifecycle transitions increment object_revision only and consume or preserve evidence only while the exact subject_revision and digest remain current. Approval requires approver != author, approved_subject_revision == current submitted_subject_revision == current subject_revision and a current target-bound step-up fact. Scheduler cursor advancement changes only next_fire_at, last_scheduled_instant_utc and fire_cursor_revision; it never changes subject_revision, object_revision or approval evidence. Activation requires approved_subject_revision == current subject_revision and the exact current schedule_policy_digest.
exactEvidencePersistence.signatureTrust: Validation resolves signature_key_id against the current trusted-key registry, verifies signature over the RFC-8785/JCS closed version document and stores the key revision and evidence digest. Activation repeats trust, revocation and digest verification; snapshot evidence never overrides a revoked key.
exactEvidencePersistence.noAdditionalTables: All evidence columns live in the declared eight tables and reference the reused shared command receipt/audit/outbox stores by public ID; no ninth SYS-006 table is permitted.

distinct WORKER, OWNER_RECOVERY and RECONCILER fence enforcement: non-null monotonic worker and reconciliation fence counters are separate from nullable core lease tuples token + leased_until + authority-fence snapshot + control-fence snapshot; each tuple is all-NULL or all-present, revoked_at is NULL while active and set when revocation clears the tuple, and worker/reconciler tuples cannot both be present; OWNER_RECOVERY selects exactly NO_ACTIVE_LEASE, WORKER_LEASE or RECONCILER_LEASE, always increments the control fence and increments/revokes only the selected lease authority

verificationPolicy.minimalTargetRule: Run each new bounded SYS-006 target group once. After a failure, diagnose and rerun only the smallest affected class, file or named case; never repeat passing targets or run a repository-wide suite per correction.

invalidationConditions: Any authority path, hash, byte count, required state or worktree identity differs.
The backend or frontend worktree is reused, relocated, merged, rebased, prepopulated, has an upstream or differs from its sealed initial head, tree or clean porcelain digest.
Platform main high-water differs from V332 or any competing V333 path exists before the owner creates the exact leased path.
The exact eight-table and five-store manifest is insufficient, an existing migration must change, a second migration, ninth table, backfill or automatic grant is required.
The matching executable SYS-006 start token v1 is absent, invalid or hash-mismatched.
Any central contract, provider binding, route/menu/child mount, activation, enrollment, customer database, direct dwp-dev merge or production action is attempted.
